reading.body:
Flexential Tampa – North publishes 3 MW of IT capacity across 60,166 square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 3 MW supports roughly 75 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, the same power supports roughly 300 racks. The operator has not published a rack count, a power density ceiling, or a cooling architecture, so which of those figures is closer to the site's actual configuration is not determinable from the data.

The certifications qualify this campus to host regulated workloads. SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 address financial and operational controls. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data. HIPAA and HITRUST qualify it for healthcare information. ISO 27001 and SSAE 18 address information security management and auditing standards broadly. None of these certifications are specific to AI training or inference, but they make the facility eligible for enterprise and regulated-industry tenants whose data governance requirements would otherwise exclude a site.

Among the 13 facilities this site has mapped in Florida, only one, this campus, has a published megawatt figure, so the state total of 3 MW reflects the limits of published data rather than the actual installed capacity of the state. Flexential Tampa – North ranks first in Florida by published IT capacity, but that ranking is an artifact of disclosure, not a claim about physical scale. Florida's broader data center footprint, and this campus's share of it, cannot be assessed until more operators publish figures.
